fares.notesEn: Suburban railway tickets are purchased on Hellenic Train's site or at stations. Tap-and-go is not currently supported on suburban gates as of this writing.

fares.notesEn: Tap and go works at metro and tram station gates with Apple Pay, Google Wallet, or any contactless Visa/Mastercard. On trams and trains you can also tap on the validators inside the vehicle. Syrmos only links to OASA's official fare list; price changes are managed by OASA.
fares.notesEl: Η ανέπαφη πληρωμή λειτουργεί στις πύλες σταθμών μετρό και τραμ με Apple Pay, Google Wallet ή οποιαδήποτε ανέπαφη κάρτα Visa/Mastercard. Στα τραμ και τα τρένα μπορείτε επίσης να σαρώσετε στα τερματικά μέσα στο όχημα. Το Syrmos απλώς παραπέμπει στον επίσημο τιμοκατάλογο του ΟΑΣΑ· οι τιμές διαχειρίζονται από τον ΟΑΣΑ.

bullets.it: Chioschi e minimarket autorizzati con il logo OASA.

bullets.en: Online top-up at athenacard.gr — register the card once, then reload any time.
bullets.el: Online ανανέωση στο athenacard.gr — εγγραφή κάρτας μία φορά, μετά φορτίζεις όποτε θες.
bullets.sq: Mbushje online në athenacard.gr — regjistro kartën një herë, pastaj mbushe kur të duash.
bullets.it: Ricarica online su athenacard.gr dopo la registrazione iniziale della carta.

bullets.en: OASA Telematics app for single tickets bought from the phone.
bullets.el: OASA Telematics εφαρμογή για μονά εισιτήρια από το κινητό.
bullets.sq: Aplikacioni OASA Telematics për bileta të vetme nga telefoni.
bullets.it: App OASA Telematics per i biglietti singoli acquistati dal telefono.

infoLinks.titleIt: Punti vendita di biglietti e carte
infoLinks.summaryIt: Dove acquistare o ricaricare ATH.ENA Card e dove trovare i biglietti cartacei.

infoLinks.summaryEn: How and when to validate so a ticket counts as legally paid.
infoLinks.summaryEl: Πώς και πότε ακυρώνεις ώστε ένα εισιτήριο να μετράει νόμιμα.
infoLinks.summarySq: Si dhe kur ta validosh që një biletë të llogaritet si e paguar ligjërisht.

bullets.en: Validate once at entry — the 90-minute window starts from the first validation.
bullets.el: Ακύρωσε μία φορά στην είσοδο — τα 90 λεπτά μετράνε από την πρώτη ακύρωση.
bullets.sq: Validoje një herë në hyrje — periudha 90-minutëshe nis nga validimi i parë.
bullets.it: Convalida all'ingresso: i 90 minuti iniziano dalla prima convalida.

bullets.en: Tap contactless (Apple Pay, Google Wallet, Visa/Mastercard) at metro and tram gates instead of buying a paper ticket.
bullets.el: Ανέπαφη χρέωση (Apple Pay, Google Wallet, Visa/Mastercard) στις πύλες μετρό και τραμ αντί για χάρτινο εισιτήριο.
bullets.sq: Paguaj pa kontakt (Apple Pay, Google Wallet, Visa/Mastercard) në portat e metros dhe tramvajit në vend që të blesh biletë letre.
bullets.it: Usa una carta contactless o un portafoglio digitale ai varchi metro e tram.

bullets.en: Inside trams and Hellenic Train suburban trains, tap the on-board contactless validators if you didn't tap at a gate.
bullets.el: Μέσα σε τραμ και προαστιακό, σάρωσε στα τερματικά μέσα στο όχημα αν δεν σάρωσες σε πύλη.
bullets.sq: Brenda tramvajeve dhe trenave periferikë të Hellenic Train, prek validatorët pa kontakt brenda mjetit nëse nuk preku në portë.
bullets.it: Su tram e treni suburbani usa i validatori a bordo se non hai convalidato al varco.

bullets.en: Free transfers between metro, tram and bus inside the 90-minute window (Airport routes are excluded).
bullets.el: Δωρεάν μετεπιβίβαση μετρό-τραμ-λεωφορείο μέσα στα 90 λεπτά (εκτός Αεροδρομίου).
bullets.sq: Transferime falas mes metros, tramvajit dhe autobusit brenda periudhës 90-minutëshe (linjat e Aeroportit përjashtohen).
bullets.it: I cambi tra metro, tram e autobus sono inclusi entro 90 minuti, escluso l'aeroporto.

bullets.en: Reduced-fare riders must carry student / senior / disability ID and show it on inspection.
bullets.el: Όσοι ταξιδεύουν με μειωμένο πρέπει να φέρουν φοιτητική / 65+ / αναπηρίας ταυτότητα στον έλεγχο.
bullets.sq: Udhëtarët me tarifë të reduktuar duhet të mbajnë kartën e studentit / 65+ / aftësive të kufizuara dhe ta tregojnë në kontroll.
bullets.it: Chi usa una tariffa ridotta deve portare il documento che ne dimostra il diritto.

bullets.en: Penalty for non-validation: 60× the basic single fare, payable on the spot or via OASA.
bullets.el: Πρόστιμο μη ακύρωσης: 60× την τιμή του απλού εισιτηρίου, στον έλεγχο ή στον OASA.
bullets.sq: Gjoba për mosvalidim: 60× tarifën bazë të biletës së vetme, e pagueshme në vend ose përmes OASA.
bullets.it: La sanzione per mancata convalida è pari a 60 volte la tariffa base.

infoLinks.summaryIt: Come e quando convalidare il titolo di viaggio.

infoLinks.titleSq: Udhëzime të përgjithshme të STASY për biletat
infoLinks.summaryEn: Rules that apply to every STASY-operated line: M1, M2, M3, T6, T7.
infoLinks.summaryEl: Κανόνες που ισχύουν σε κάθε γραμμή STASY: Μ1, Μ2, Μ3, Τ6, Τ7.
infoLinks.summarySq: Rregulla që zbatohen për çdo linjë të operuar nga STASY: M1, M2, M3, T6, T7.

bullets.en: Buy or activate the ticket before boarding — there are no on-train or on-tram sales.
bullets.el: Αγόρασε ή ενεργοποίησε το εισιτήριο πριν επιβιβαστείς — δεν υπάρχει πώληση μέσα στο όχημα.
bullets.sq: Bli ose aktivizo biletën para se të hipësh — nuk ka shitje brenda trenit ose tramvajit.
bullets.it: Acquista o attiva il biglietto prima di salire a bordo.

bullets.en: Reduced fare: under 18, over 65 with proof, students with a Greek academic ID, persons with disability.
bullets.el: Μειωμένο: κάτω των 18, άνω των 65 με δικαιολογητικό, φοιτητές με ακαδημαϊκή ταυτότητα, ΑμεΑ.
bullets.sq: Tarifë e reduktuar: nën 18 vjeç, mbi 65 vjeç me dëshmi, studentët me kartë akademike greke, personat me aftësi të kufizuara.
bullets.it: Tariffa ridotta per le categorie aventi diritto con documento valido.

bullets.en: Free travel: children under 6, persons with disability above 67% (and accompanying carer where required).
bullets.el: Δωρεάν: παιδιά κάτω των 6, ΑμεΑ με αναπηρία άνω του 67% (και συνοδός όπου απαιτείται).
bullets.sq: Udhëtim falas: fëmijë nën 6 vjeç, persona me aftësi të kufizuara mbi 67% (dhe kujdestari shoqërues kur kërkohet).
bullets.it: Viaggio gratuito per i bambini sotto i 6 anni e per le categorie previste.

bullets.en: Keep the ticket or contactless receipt visible until you exit the station.
bullets.el: Φύλαξε το εισιτήριο ή την απόδειξη ανέπαφης χρέωσης μέχρι να βγεις από τον σταθμό.
bullets.sq: Mbaj biletën ose faturën pa kontakt të dukshme derisa të dalësh nga stacioni.
bullets.it: Conserva il biglietto o la prova contactless fino all'uscita dalla stazione.

bullets.en: Refunds and lost-card replacements go through the OASA central office, not the station.
bullets.el: Επιστροφές και αντικατάσταση χαμένης κάρτας γίνονται στα κεντρικά γραφεία OASA, όχι στον σταθμό.
bullets.sq: Rimbursimet dhe zëvendësimi i kartave të humbura kalojnë përmes zyrës qendrore të OASA, jo në stacion.
bullets.it: Rimborsi e sostituzioni delle carte smarrite sono gestiti dagli uffici centrali OASA.

infoLinks.summaryIt: Regole valide sulle linee STASY M1, M2, M3, T6 e T7.

infoLinks.summaryEn: Suburban rail lines operated by Hellenic Train in Athens, Thessaloniki and Patras.
infoLinks.summaryEl: Γραμμες προαστιακου σιδηροδρομου Hellenic Train σε Αθηνα, Θεσσαλονικη και Πατρα.
infoLinks.summarySq: Linjat hekurudhore periferike te operuara nga Hellenic Train ne Athine, Selanik dhe Patra.

bullets.en: Athens suburban (Proastiakos): Piraeus - Airport, Piraeus - Kiato, Athens - Chalkida, Athens - Ano Liosia.
bullets.el: Προαστιακος Αθηνας: Πειραιας - Αεροδρομιο, Πειραιας - Κιατο, Αθηνα - Χαλκιδα, Αθηνα - Ανω Λιοσια.
bullets.sq: Suburban i Athines: Piraeus - Aeroport, Piraeus - Kiato, Athine - Halkida, Athine - Ano Liosia.
bullets.it: Atene: Pireo - Aeroporto, Pireo - Kiato, Atene - Chalkida e Atene - Ano Liosia.

bullets.en: Thessaloniki suburban: New Railway Station - Larisa, New Railway Station - Florina, Thessaloniki - Edessa.
bullets.el: Προαστιακος Θεσσαλονικης: Νεος Σιδηροδρομικος - Λαρισα, Νεος Σιδηροδρομικος - Φλωρινα, Θεσσαλονικη - Εδεσσα.
bullets.sq: Suburban i Selanikut: Stacioni i Ri - Larisa, Stacioni i Ri - Florina, Selanik - Edesa.
bullets.it: Salonicco: Nuova stazione - Larissa, Florina ed Edessa.

bullets.en: Patras suburban: Rio - Patras - Kiato (along the Gulf of Corinth coast).
bullets.el: Προαστιακος Πατρας: Ριο - Πατρα - Κιατο (κατα μηκος της ακτης του Κορινθιακου).
bullets.sq: Suburban i Patres: Rio - Patra - Kiato (pergjate bregut te Gjirit te Korintit).
bullets.it: Patrasso: rete suburbana con collegamenti autobus inclusi nelle tratte indicate.

bullets.en: Tickets: buy at station counters, vending machines, or online at hellenictrain.gr. No on-board sales on suburban trains.
bullets.el: Εισιτηρια: αγορα σε εκδοτηρια σταθμων, αυτοματα μηχανηματα, η online στο hellenictrain.gr. Δεν πωλουνται εισιτηρια μεσα στο τρενο.
bullets.sq: Bileta: blini ne sportelet e stacioneve, aparate automatike, ose online ne hellenictrain.gr. Nuk ka shitje brenda trenit.
bullets.it: Acquista i biglietti in stazione, ai distributori o online su hellenictrain.gr.

bullets.en: Reduced fares: students, seniors 65+, military, families with 3+ children, persons with disability (carry ID).
bullets.el: Μειωμενα: φοιτητες, ανω των 65, στρατιωτικοι, πολυτεκνοι, ΑμεΑ (με ταυτοτητα).
bullets.sq: Tarifa te reduktuara: studente, mbi 65 vjec, ushtarake, familje me 3+ femije, persona me aftesi te kufizuara (me dokument).
bullets.it: Sono disponibili tariffe ridotte per le categorie aventi diritto con documento.

infoLinks.summaryIt: Linee suburbane Hellenic Train ad Atene, Salonicco e Patrasso.

infoLinks.summaryEn: Long-distance and regional trains connecting major Greek cities.
infoLinks.summaryEl: Υπεραστικα και περιφερειακα τρενα που συνδεουν τις μεγαλες πολεις της Ελλαδας.
infoLinks.summarySq: Trena nderqytetese dhe rajonale qe lidhin qytetet kryesore te Greqise.

bullets.en: Main intercity routes: Athens - Thessaloniki (4h), Athens - Larisa (3h), Thessaloniki - Larisa (1.5h), Thessaloniki - Alexandroupoli.
bullets.el: Κυριες υπεραστικες γραμμες: Αθηνα - Θεσσαλονικη (4ω), Αθηνα - Λαρισα (3ω), Θεσσαλονικη - Λαρισα (1.5ω), Θεσσαλονικη - Αλεξανδρουπολη.
bullets.sq: Linjat kryesore nderqytetese: Athine - Selanik (4h), Athine - Larisa (3h), Selanik - Larisa (1.5h), Selanik - Aleksandrupoli.
bullets.it: Le principali tratte includono Atene - Salonicco, Atene - Larissa e Salonicco - Larissa.

bullets.en: Tickets priced by route, date and class. Book early for up to 15% off, return tickets 20% off, students up to 50% off.
bullets.el: Τιμες αναλογα με διαδρομη, ημερα και θεση. Εγκαιρη κρατηση εως 15% εκπτωση, εισιτηριο μετ' επιστροφης 20%, φοιτητες εως 50%.
bullets.sq: Cmimet sipas rruges, dates dhe klases. Rezervim i hershëm deri 15% zbritje, bileta vajtje-ardhje 20%, studente deri 50%.
bullets.it: Il prezzo dipende da tratta, data e classe, con sconti secondo l'idoneità.

bullets.en: Book online at hellenictrain.gr, at station ticket offices, or via the Hellenic Train app.
bullets.el: Κρατηση online στο hellenictrain.gr, σε εκδοτηρια σταθμων, η μεσω της εφαρμογης Hellenic Train.
bullets.sq: Rezervo online ne hellenictrain.gr, ne sportelet e stacioneve, ose nepermjet aplikacionit Hellenic Train.
bullets.it: Prenota online, in biglietteria o tramite l'app Hellenic Train.

bullets.en: Free travel: children under 4 (without seat reservation), train crew, police on duty.
bullets.el: Δωρεαν: παιδια κατω των 4 (χωρις θεση), προσωπικο τρενου, αστυνομικοι εν ωρα υπηρεσιας.
bullets.sq: Falas: femije nen 4 vjec (pa rezervim ulëseje), ekuipazhi i trenit, policia ne sherbim.
bullets.it: I bambini sotto i 4 anni viaggiano gratis senza posto riservato.

bullets.en: Delay compensation is 25% of the fare for 60 to 119 minutes and 50% for 120 minutes or more, subject to the official conditions.
bullets.el: Η αποζημιωση καθυστερησης ειναι 25% του κομιστρου για 60 ως 119 λεπτα και 50% για 120 λεπτα η περισσοτερο, με βαση τους επισημους ορους.
bullets.sq: Kompensimi per vonesen eshte 25% e biletes per 60 deri ne 119 minuta dhe 50% per 120 minuta ose me shume, sipas kushteve zyrtare.
bullets.it: Verifica le condizioni ufficiali per rimborsi dovuti a ritardi o cancellazioni.

infoLinks.summaryIt: Treni a lunga percorrenza e regionali tra le principali città greche.
